This file contains monthly, seasonal and annual 1991-2020 Maximum, Minimum and Mean Temperatures on a 1X1km grid
Data for Ireland 
Reference: Climatological Note No. 23 - Long-term air temperature averages for Ireland 1991-2020 
Coordinates are Irish Grid TM65 
Temperatures are in degrees Celsius and tenths.
Data in this file are (c)  copyright Met Éireann
